chunks: "The protected area (harim) of a mosque is forty cubits from every side, and the protected area (harim) of a believer in the summer is a span."

key_terms.الصَّيْفِ: the summer season, in which this measure applies
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدِ: the mosque, whose surrounding reserved space is being defined
key_terms.الْمُؤْمِنِ: the believer, whose personal protected space is mentioned
key_terms.بَاعٌ: a span, a unit of bodily measurement
key_terms.حَرِيمَ: a protected or reserved boundary area
key_terms.ذِرَاعًا: a cubit, a unit of length

ai.seo_question: What is the prescribed harim of a mosque and the personal harim of a believer in this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal measure for the harim of a mosque, setting it at forty cubits on every side. It also mentions the personal harim of a believer in summer, indicating a protected personal space measured by a span, with another narration giving the measure as the length of a cubit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "The protected area (harim) of a mosque is forty cubits from every side, and the protected area (harim) of a believer in the summer is a span."
